type.description: checkout counter (belt, scanner, register screens, a lit number sign above), shopping cart, hand basket, coin locker, entrance gate, ceiling track with spotlight heads (origin at the top of the rail; the lights that light things are placed by the scene at trackSpots), self-checkout kiosk (customer at +Z: scanner glass, lit touch screen, receipt printer with a strip of paper, card reader, bagging scale with a bag rack holding an open bag, a numbered status light pole)

color.description: main color (sRGB #rrggbb; by type when missing)

number.description: number on the checkout sign (needs the font)

font.description: font of the checkout sign; content path of a font asset (no extension)

tilt.description: how far the heads tilt from straight down toward the front (+Z), degrees
